title: Quran Quiz: Quran Mein Kitni Surahs Hain?

scenes.text: Assalamu Alaikum dosto! Aaj ka Quran quiz shuru karte hain.
Sawal yeh hai: Quran-e-Pak mein kitni surahs hain?
Jawab hai: ek sau chaudah, yaani 114 surahs!
Sab se pehli surah Al-Fatiha, aur sab se aakhri surah An-Naas hai.
Agar aap ko pata tha to comment mein likhein, aur video share karein. Jazakallah!
